Economy · India

Commercial LPG Prices Cut, Trump Faces Drug Pricing Resistance

Commercial LPG cylinder prices in India have been reduced by Rs 183.50, offering relief to businesses. Meanwhile, US President Trump's initiative to lower drug prices globally is encountering opposition from mid-sized pharmaceutical companies. Separately, Trump has also urged US gasoline retailers to reduce prices, warning of consequences if they do not comply.
